Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the swing-arm ball at φ60, φ70 and φ80, in white or black, upper or lower, sold per piece from Xingtai. directAnswer.zh: 《泵》是百科页。混凝土泵摆臂球头细节图仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 河北品锦机械把摆臂球头列为 φ60、φ70、φ80，分白或黑、上或下，按个从邢台供货。随该配件存放、尚未用过的细节照片没有印直径、颜色名称、泵型号或材料牌号。这些空栏保持空白。页面没有标价，也不按小包裹销售。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Types”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. The page Concrete Pump Swing-Arm Ball calls the part a swing-arm / pendulum-arm ball head. Sizes listed: φ60 / φ70 / φ80. Variants listed: white or black, upper or lower. Unit: piece. The commercial-terms cell prints: no small-batch shipping. no published list price. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“类型”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 混凝土泵摆臂球头这一页把配件写成摆臂球头。已列尺寸：φ60 / φ70 / φ80。已列规格：白色或黑色，上部或下部。单位：个。页面商务条款：不支持小批量发货，无公开标价，请在泵上核对尺寸，替换易损件，不是其他品牌原厂件。 随该配件存放的细节文件与页面主图不是同一张，也还没有被文章用过。照片上没有印 φ 尺寸、白或黑、上或下、材料牌号或泵型号。使用寿命同样是缺字段。数字相同的摆缸密封是另一页，不随球头一起供给。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Pump repairs”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. confirm the OD on the pump. replacement wear parts, not OEM branded parts. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“来源章节：Pump repairs”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械。写明摆臂球头、一个已印尺寸（φ60、φ70 或 φ80）、白或黑、上或下，以及个数。材料牌号和寿命留空。本文由品锦邢台工厂（河北品锦机械 / Hebei Pinjin Machinery）编写。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Applications” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. The detail file stored with this spare is a separate photograph from the page hero, and it has not been used as an article image. It does not print a φ size, a white/black label, an upper/lower position, a material grade or a pump model. Service life is also a missing field. A swing-cylinder seal that uses the same numeral is a different page and is not included with the ball. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp to Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Name the swing-arm ball, one printed size (φ60, φ70 or φ80), white or black, upper or lower, and the quantity in pieces. Leave material grade and service life blank. This note is written by the Pinjin Xingtai factory (Hebei Pinjin Machinery / 品锦机械). No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “用途”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 河北品锦机械把摆臂球头列为 φ60、φ70、φ80，分白或黑、上或下，按个从邢台供货。随该配件存放、尚未用过的细节照片没有印直径、颜色名称、泵型号或材料牌号。这些空栏保持空白。页面没有标价，也不按小包裹销售。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Specifications” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the swing-arm ball at φ60, φ70 and φ80, in white or black, upper or lower, sold per piece from Xingtai. The unused detail photograph filed with that spare does not print a diameter, a colour name, a pump model or a material grade. Those blanks stay blank. No list price is printed, and the page does not sell the ball as a small parcel. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “规格”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 没有。直径要按配件页抄，页面列出 φ60、φ70、φ80。照片本身没有尺寸，这一栏是缺字段。 配件页没有点名泵型号。请在机器上核对 φ60、φ70 或 φ80，以及上部或下部。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Pumping power” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. No. The diameter has to be copied from the spare page, which lists φ60, φ70 and φ80. The photograph itself is a missing-size field. The spare page does not name a pump model. Confirm φ60, φ70 or φ80, and upper or lower, on the machine. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “泵送功率”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 材料牌号和使用寿命都没有印出。两栏都留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Efficiency” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Neither a material grade nor a service life is printed. Leave both fields blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “效率”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Use “Minimum flow protection” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Name the swing-arm ball page, the size, the colour, the upper or lower position, and the quantity. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump
